note: DOGFOOD-1 judge-set ladder. shared_assignments is applied to EVERY set so all sets run through the authored DSPy trio + the withstands-gate (gate ON for all) — the ONLY independent variable across the model-mix sets is `models`, so the composition contrast is apples-to-apples (no gate-on/off confound). The roster_* sets vary `roles` to show the roster-size ladder; a single-role roster is intentionally absent because the frozen _apply_consensus requires len(valid) >= 2 (single-judge support is a consensus-policy decision, not shipped here — see the runbook seam).
